voice.summary: Ringtale talks in the clipped, friendly way people caption a story: lowercase-leaning, brisk and a little playful. Instructions are tiny because a story is only seconds long.
dos: Give instructions in four words or fewer
Use first names and handles as written

taglines: Tap a ring, see the story
Hold to pause, tap to skip
boilerplate: Ringtale is a stories player with segmented progress bars, tap zones and hold-to-pause, made for short visual updates from friends and creators.

microcopy.error: This story could not load. Tap to retry.
microcopy.empty: No new stories. You are all caught up.

logo.note: A ring is the tappable avatar the product is built around.
